spells.notes: 전두환 appointee (7·13 개각). Named on 1987-07-13 (중앙일보 1987-07-14, BigKinds 01100901.19870714194838001, '전두환대통령은 13일 하오 ... 국방장관에 정호용전내무장관'), 임명장 on the morning of 1987-07-14, and 이·취임식 with 이기백 that afternoon. Start predates the window. Caretaker holdover under 노태우 for part of 1988-02-25. The 5공 cabinet's 일괄사표 was accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 and the new ministers received their 임명장 the same morning (11:40 per 서울신문 1988-02-26, BigKinds 01100611.19880226163159002, search snapshot roster/sources/defense/ext88/probe/bk_임명장_1988-02-24_1988-02-27.json), so his last day in office is 1988-02-25, the successor's appointment day, as in the main roster's handover convention. He had refused reappointment (경향신문 1988-02-20 p.10 '鄭국방 退陣재고요청 거절', News Library 1988022000329210014). The 국방부 list and ko.wikipedia both end his term on 1988.2.25. Birth date agrees in na_members_12_22.csv (term 13 and 14 rows, 1932-09-10) and ko.wikipedia (ko.wikipedia "정호용" https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42493525 (snapshot roster/sources/defense/ext88/bios/wiki_정호용.json, accessed 2026-09-26T09:43:10-0400), infobox 출생일 1932-09-10). No digital 관보 exists before 2001, so dates rest on the 국방부 list (tier 2), the 대통령기록관 schedule or 국사편찬위 연표 (tier 2) and same-day news from two archives with different outlets (tier 3).

spells.notes: Air force general, 합참의장 when named on 1994-12-23 and discharged that day (동아일보 1994-12-24 p.1 '李신임국방장관은 이 날짜로예편했다'). The start date is the 임명장 ceremony of 1994-12-24, which the 국방부 list and ko.wikipedia also give. No story names him at that ceremony, but the only absentees reported were 공노명, 한승수 and 유종하. Removed on the afternoon of 1996-10-17 in a '전격 경질'. 한국일보 1996-10-18 (BigKinds 01101101.19961018000000301) calls it '사실상 문책성', 매일신문 1996-10-18 (01500601.19961018121904001) '문책성' and 강원도민일보 1996-10-18 (01300101.20160615083255434) '공비침투 등 문책' (search snapshot roster/sources/defense/ext88/events/bk_T_1996_10_김동진.json). The successor received his 임명장 on the morning of 1996-10-18 and 이양호 held his 이임식 at 11:00 that day, so the last day is 1996-10-18, matching the main roster's start for 김동진. The 군사기밀 유출 allegations were made public by 국민회의 at an afternoon briefing on 1996-10-17 after the removal (세계일보 1996-10-18, BigKinds 01100701.19961018000000102, search snapshot roster/sources/defense/ext88/appt/bk_T_1996_10_김동진.json), and the President ordered an investigation on 1996-10-18 (연표). Birth date from ko.wikipedia (ko.wikipedia "이양호 (1937년)" https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42493747 (snapshot roster/sources/defense/ext88/bios/wiki_이양호_1937년_.json, accessed 2026-09-26T09:43:14-0400), infobox 출생일 1937-06-16). No digital 관보 exists before 2001, so dates rest on the 국방부 list (tier 2), the 대통령기록관 schedule or 국사편찬위 연표 (tier 2) and same-day news from two archives with different outlets (tier 3).

issues.desc: Cross-lineage convention for the 1988-02-25 holdovers. The 5공 cabinet's 일괄사표 was accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 매일경제 1988-02-25, 중앙일보 1988-02-25), after 노태우's term began at 0시, and the new ministers received their 임명장 at 11:40 that morning. This file therefore ends 정호용 on 1988-02-25 and includes him as a one-day holdover (appointing_president 전두환). Pages with a day-before convention print 1988-02-24 for other 5공 ministers (the culture checkpoint copies MCST's 이웅희 end 1988-02-24). If other lineages end their 5공 holders on 1988-02-24 they drop out of the window, and the panel would treat 국방부 differently from the other ministries. The orchestrator should apply one convention.

Announcement and 임명장 fall on different days in six handovers: 1987-07-13/14, 1988-02-19/25, 1991-12-19/20, 1993-12-21/22, 1994-12-23/24 and 1996-10-17/18. Starts use the 임명장 date, which the 국방부 list gives in every case and which follows the main roster's 1996-10-18 start for 김동진. The nominations record the announcement date. The 국사편찬위 연표 dates the 1991, 1993 and 1994 reshuffles by the announcement day, and the 1988 announcements came from the president-elect before he took office.

ko.wikipedia (revid 42533700) gives 1988-12-04 as 이상훈's start. The 국방부 list gives 1988.12.5 and same-day news (동아일보 and 경향신문 1988-12-05, 한국일보 and 한겨레 1988-12-06) put the 임명장 on the afternoon of 1988-12-05. This file uses 1988-12-05.

The 국방부 list is not consistent about end dates. 오자복 is printed '88. 02. 25 ~ 88. 12. 4' (day before the successor), while every other row in 1987-1996 ends on the successor's start day. 권영해's end is blank. This file ends each spell on the successor's appointment day.

이양호's 임명장 date (1994-12-24) is inferred from the collective ceremony for the new cabinet that morning. Papers of 1994-12-24 say he was named and discharged from the air force on 1994-12-23 and attended his own 합참의장 이임 및 전역식 that afternoon as 신임 국방장관, but no story names him at the 12-24 ceremony. The 국방부 list and ko.wikipedia both give 1994-12-24.

The 이·취임식 was held the day after the legal handover in 1988-02 (26일, 한국일보 and 경향신문 1988-02-26) and 1988-12 (12-06, 동아일보 1988-12-06). End dates for 정호용 and 오자복 follow the 사표 수리 and the successor's 임명장, not the ceremony.
